description: §41.12.1 rules 2 + 5 — a literal registerMessages template with a `{` that opens no slot is refused with E-MESSAGE-TEMPLATE-MALFORMED, once per bad template: `{ field }` (a slot has no whitespace) and an unclosed `{predicate`.
rationale: §41.12.1 grammar: a slot is exactly `{`, a name, `}`; `{{` is the only escape. Rule 2: any other text after a single `{` makes the template malformed. Rule 5: checked at compile time when the template is a literal. Two bad templates → two diagnostics.
